system.description:
The Lament of Stars was the first lament learned by the Elves. As they left their ancestral homeland and crossed the sea to their new home, the bards composed this song to ease the heart pain and homesickness. This lament obeys all the standard rules for laments. See the Grief section for more on that.

Obstacle: See Grief Section

Actions: Hours equal to obstacle

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 147
